**Finding: compliant — no redline proposed.**

The Agreement contains no Vendor audit right against Tri City National Bank. All audit/examination machinery runs in our favour:

- **§ 21.9(C) (p0277)** — M&I must procure an annual independent third-party review of *its own* data processing centre, the Operations Center and related internal controls, give us a copy of the report free of charge, and promptly implement recommended changes.
- **§ 21.9(B) (p0276) / § 21.8 (p0274)** — examination access for our Federal Regulators over M&I's performance and records, with M&I notice obligations to us.
- **§ 17.1 (p0243)** — Customer Data remains subject to examination by our auditors and regulators as if held on our premises.
- **§ 22.12 (p0300)** — M&I financial statement delivery to us.

Targeted searches for audit/inspect/verify/examine, monitoring, licence-compliance or usage/fee verification, books-and-records access, and on-site or remote access to Customer facilities surfaced no M&I right to audit our usage, fees or systems. Because nothing binds us, there is no frequency, notice, cost-allocation or system-access exposure to constrain, and inserting an audit-limitation clause would only create the audit right the contract currently omits.

One item noted in the rationale but deliberately not flagged: **§ 21.7(C) (p0273)** requires us to provide evidence on request that the Agreement is properly reflected on our books. That is a narrow documentary confirmation of a representation — no inspection, verification or system access — so it falls outside the AUDIT rule rather than constituting an unlimited audit right.
